verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֨י הַדְּבָרִ֤ים וְהָאֱמֶת֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה בָּ֖א סַנְחֵרִ֣יב מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁ֑וּר וַיָּבֹ֣א בִֽיהוּדָ֗ה וַיִּ֙חַן֙ עַל־ הֶעָרִ֣ים הַבְּצֻר֔וֹת וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לְבִקְעָ֥ם אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rê had·də·ḇā·rîm wə·hā·’ĕ·meṯ hā·’êl·leh bā san·ḥê·rîḇ me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr way·yā·ḇō ḇî·hū·ḏāh way·yi·ḥan ‘al- he·‘ā·rîm hab·bə·ṣu·rō·wṯ way·yō·mer lə·ḇiq·‘ām ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: After all these acts of faithfulness Sennacherib king of Assyria came and invaded Judah He laid siege to the fortified cities intending to conquer them for himself
verses.literalPt: DEPOIS destas coisas e desta verdade, veio Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria, e entrou em Judá, e acampou-se contra as cidades fortificadas, e intentou apoderar-se delas.

verses.original: וַיַּרְא֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ כִּי־ בָ֖א סַנְחֵרִ֑יב וּפָנָ֕יו לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū kî- ḇā san·ḥê·rîḇ ū·p̄ā·nāw lam·mil·ḥā·māh ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: When Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib . . . had come to make war against Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Vendo, pois, Ezequias que Senaqueribe vinha, e que estava resolvido contra Jerusalém,

verses.original: וַיִּוָּעַ֗ץ עִם־ שָׂרָיו֙ וְגִבֹּרָ֔יו לִסְתּוֹם֙ אֶת־ מֵימֵ֣י הָעֲיָנ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֑יר וַֽיַּעְזְרֽוּהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiw·wā·‘aṣ ‘im- śā·rāw wə·ḡib·bō·rāw lis·tō·wm ’eṯ- mê·mê hā·‘ă·yā·nō·wṯ ’ă·šer mi·ḥūṣ lā·‘îr way·ya‘·zə·rū·hū
verses.literal: he consulted with his leaders and mighty men about stopping up the waters of the springs outside the city and they helped him carry it out
verses.literalPt: Teve conselho com os seus príncipes e os seus homens valentes, para que se tapassem as fontes das águas que havia fora da cidade; e eles o ajudaram.

verses.original: וַיִּקָּבְצ֣וּ עַם־ רָ֔ב וַֽיִּסְתְּמוּ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמַּעְיָנ֔וֹת וְאֶת־ הַנַּ֛חַל הַשּׁוֹטֵ֥ף בְּתוֹךְ־ הָאָ֖רֶץ לֵאמֹ֑ר לָ֤מָּה יָב֙וֹאוּ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י אַשּׁ֔וּר וּמָצְא֖וּ מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū ‘am- rāḇ way·yis·tə·mū ’eṯ- kāl- ham·ma‘·yā·nō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- han·na·ḥal haš·šō·w·ṭêp̄ bə·ṯō·wḵ- hā·’ā·reṣ lê·mōr lām·māh yā·ḇō·w·’ū mal·ḵê ’aš·šūr ū·mā·ṣə·’ū ma·yim rab·bîm
verses.literal: Many people assembled and stopped up all the springs and the stream that flowed through the land Why should the kings of Assyria come and find plenty of water they said
verses.literalPt: Assim muito povo se ajuntou, e tapou todas as fontes, como também o ribeiro que se estendia pelo meio da terra, dizendo: Por que viriam os reis da Assíria, e achariam tantas águas?

verses.original: וַיִּתְחַזַּ֡ק וַיִּבֶן֩ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַחוֹמָ֨ה הַפְּרוּצָ֜ה וַיַּ֣עַל עַל־ הַמִּגְדָּל֗וֹת וְלַח֙וּצָה֙ הַחוֹמָ֣ה אַחֶ֔רֶת וַיְחַזֵּ֥ק אֶת־ הַמִּלּ֖וֹא עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַיַּ֥עַשׂ שֶׁ֛לַח לָרֹ֖ב וּמָגִנִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·ḥaz·zaq way·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- kāl- ha·ḥō·w·māh hap·pə·rū·ṣāh way·ya·‘al ‘al- ham·miḡ·dā·lō·wṯ wə·la·ḥū·ṣāh ha·ḥō·w·māh ’a·ḥe·reṯ way·ḥaz·zêq ’eṯ- ham·mil·lō·w ‘îr dā·wîḏ way·ya·‘aś še·laḥ lā·rōḇ ū·mā·ḡin·nîm
verses.literal: Then Hezekiah worked resolutely to rebuild all the broken sections of the wall and to raise up . . . towers on it He also built an outer wall and reinforced the supporting terraces of the City of David and he produced an abundance of weapons and shields
verses.literalPt: E ele se animou, e edificou todo o muro quebrado até às torres, e levantou o outro muro por fora; e fortificou a Milo na cidade de Davi, e fez armas e escudos em abundância.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֛ן שָׂרֵ֥י מִלְחָמ֖וֹת עַל־ הָעָ֑ם וַיִּקְבְּצֵ֣ם אֵלָ֗יו אֶל־ רְחוֹב֙ שַׁ֣עַר הָעִ֔יר וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר עַל־ לְבָבָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên śā·rê mil·ḥā·mō·wṯ ‘al- hā·‘ām way·yiq·bə·ṣêm ’ê·lāw ’el- rə·ḥō·wḇ ša·‘ar hā·‘îr way·ḏab·bêr ‘al- lə·ḇā·ḇām lê·mōr
verses.literal: Hezekiah appointed military commanders over the people and gathered the people in . . . the square of the city gate Then he encouraged . . . them saying
verses.literalPt: E pôs capitães de guerra sobre o povo, e reuniu-os na praça da porta da cidade, e falou-lhes ao coração, dizendo:

verses.original: חִזְק֣וּ וְאִמְצ֔וּ אַל־ תִּֽירְא֣וּ וְאַל־ תֵּחַ֗תּוּ מִפְּנֵי֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וּמִלִּפְנֵ֖י כָּל־ הֶהָמ֣וֹן אֲשֶׁר־ עִמּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ עִמָּ֥נוּ רַ֖ב מֵעִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥiz·qū wə·’im·ṣū ’al- tî·rə·’ū wə·’al- tê·ḥat·tū mip·pə·nê me·leḵ ’aš·šūr ū·mil·lip̄·nê kāl- he·hā·mō·wn ’ă·šer- ‘im·mōw kî- ‘im·mā·nū raḇ mê·‘im·mōw
verses.literal: Be strong and courageous Do not be afraid . . . or discouraged before the king of Assyria and . . . the vast army with him for there is a greater One with us than with him
verses.literalPt: Esforçai-vos, e tende bom ânimo; não temais, nem vos espanteis, por causa do rei da Assíria, nem por causa de toda a multidão que está com ele, porque há um maior conosco do que com ele.

verses.original: עִמּוֹ֙ זְר֣וֹעַ בָּשָׂ֔ר וְעִמָּ֜נוּ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ לְעָזְרֵ֔נוּ וּלְהִלָּחֵ֖ם מִלְחֲמֹתֵ֑נוּ וַיִּסָּמְכ֣וּ הָעָ֔ם עַל־ דִּבְרֵ֖י יְחִזְקִיָּ֥הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘im·mōw zə·rō·w·a‘ bā·śār wə·‘im·mā·nū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū lə·‘ā·zə·rê·nū ū·lə·hil·lā·ḥêm mil·ḥă·mō·ṯê·nū way·yis·sā·mə·ḵū hā·‘ām ‘al- diḇ·rê yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: With him is only the arm of flesh but with us is the LORD our God to help us and to fight our battles So the people were strengthened by the words of Hezekiah king of Judah
verses.literalPt: Com ele está o braço de carne, mas conosco o SENHOR nosso Deus, para nos ajudar, e para guerrear por nós. E o povo descansou nas palavras de Ezequias, rei de Judá.

verses.original: אַ֣חַר זֶ֗ה שָׁ֠לַח סַנְחֵרִ֨יב מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁ֤וּר עֲבָדָיו֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔יְמָה וְהוּא֙ עַל־ לָכִ֔ישׁ וְכָל־ מֶמְשַׁלְתּ֖וֹ עִמּ֑וֹ עַל־ יְחִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְעַל־ כָּל־ יְהוּדָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥar zeh šā·laḥ san·ḥê·rîḇ me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw yə·rū·šā·lay·māh wə·hū ‘al- lā·ḵîš wə·ḵāl mem·šal·tōw ‘im·mōw ‘al- yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh wə·‘al- kāl- yə·hū·ḏāh ’ă·šer bî·rū·šā·lim lê·mōr
verses.literal: Later . . . as Sennacherib king of Assyria and all his forces . . . besieged Lachish he sent his servants to Jerusalem with a message for King Hezekiah of Judah . . . and all the people of Judah who were in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Depois disto Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria, enviou os seus servos a Jerusalém (ele porém estava diante de Laquis, com todas as suas forças), a Ezequias, rei de Judá, e a todo o Judá que estava em Jerusalém, dizendo:

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֔ר סַנְחֵרִ֖יב מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר עַל־ מָה֙ אַתֶּ֣ם בֹּטְחִ֔ים וְיֹשְׁבִ֥ים בְּמָצ֖וֹר בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar san·ḥê·rîḇ me·leḵ ’aš·šūr ‘al- māh ’at·tem bō·ṭə·ḥîm wə·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·mā·ṣō·wr bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: This is what Sennacherib king of Assyria says What is the basis of your confidence that you remain in Jerusalem under siege
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria: Em que confiais vós, para vos deixardes sitiar em Jerusalém?

verses.original: הֲלֹ֤א יְחִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ מַסִּ֣ית אֶתְכֶ֔ם לָתֵ֣ת אֶתְכֶ֔ם לָמ֛וּת בְּרָעָ֥ב וּבְצָמָ֖א לֵאמֹ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ יַצִּילֵ֕נוּ מִכַּ֖ף מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū mas·sîṯ ’eṯ·ḵem lā·ṯêṯ ’eṯ·ḵem lā·mūṯ bə·rā·‘āḇ ū·ḇə·ṣā·mā lê·mōr Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū yaṣ·ṣî·lê·nū mik·kap̄ me·leḵ ’aš·šūr
verses.literal: Is not Hezekiah misleading you to give you over to death by famine and thirst when he says The LORD our God will deliver us from the hand of the king of Assyria
verses.literalPt: Porventura não vos incita Ezequias, para morrerdes à fome e à sede, dizendo: O SENHOR nosso Deus nos livrará das mãos do rei da Assíria?

verses.original: הֲלֹא־ הוּא֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ הֵסִ֥יר אֶת־ בָּמֹתָ֖יו וְאֶת־ מִזְבְּחֹתָ֑יו וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לִֽיהוּדָ֤ה וְלִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לִפְנֵ֨י מִזְבֵּ֧חַ אֶחָ֛ד תִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ וְעָלָ֥יו תַּקְטִֽירוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- hū yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū hê·sîr ’eṯ- bā·mō·ṯāw wə·’eṯ- miz·bə·ḥō·ṯāw way·yō·mer lî·hū·ḏāh wə·lî·rū·šā·lim lê·mōr lip̄·nê miz·bê·aḥ ’e·ḥāḏ tiš·ta·ḥă·wū wə·‘ā·lāw taq·ṭî·rū
verses.literal: Did not Hezekiah himself remove His high places and His altars and say to Judah and Jerusalem . . . You must worship before one altar and on it you shall burn sacrifices
verses.literalPt: Não é Ezequias o mesmo que tirou os seus altos e os seus altares, e falou a Judá e a Jerusalém, dizendo: Diante de um único altar vos prostrareis, e sobre ele queimareis incenso?

verses.original: הֲלֹ֣א תֵדְע֗וּ מֶ֤ה עָשִׂ֙יתִי֙ אֲנִ֣י וַאֲבוֹתַ֔י לְכֹ֖ל עַמֵּ֣י הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת הֲיָכ֣וֹל יָֽכְל֗וּ אֱלֹהֵי֙ גּוֹיֵ֣ הָאֲרָצ֔וֹת לְהַצִּ֥יל אֶת־ אַרְצָ֖ם מִיָּדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō ṯê·ḏə·‘ū meh ‘ā·śî·ṯî ’ă·nî wa·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯay lə·ḵōl ‘am·mê hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ hă·yā·ḵō·wl yā·ḵə·lū ’ĕ·lō·hê gō·w·yê hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ lə·haṣ·ṣîl ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣām mî·yā·ḏî
verses.literal: Do you not know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the lands Have the gods of these nations ever been able . . . to deliver their land from my hand
verses.literalPt: Não sabeis vós o que eu e meus pais fizemos a todos os povos das terras? Porventura puderam de qualquer maneira os deuses das nações daquelas terras livrar o seu país da minha mão?

verses.original: מִ֠י בְּֽכָל־ אֱלֹהֵ֞י הַגּוֹיִ֤ם הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶחֱרִ֣ימוּ אֲבוֹתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָכ֔וֹל לְהַצִּ֥יל אֶת־ עַמּ֖וֹ מִיָּדִ֑י כִּ֤י יוּכַל֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם לְהַצִּ֥יל אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִיָּדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mî bə·ḵāl ’ĕ·lō·hê hag·gō·w·yim hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer he·ḥĕ·rî·mū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯay ’ă·šer yā·ḵō·wl lə·haṣ·ṣîl ’eṯ- ‘am·mōw mî·yā·ḏî kî yū·ḵal ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem lə·haṣ·ṣîl ’eṯ·ḵem mî·yā·ḏî
verses.literal: Who among all the gods of these nations that my fathers devoted to destruction has been able to deliver his people from my hand How then can your God deliver you from my hand
verses.literalPt: Qual é, de todos os deuses daquelas nações que meus pais destruíram, o que pôde livrar o seu povo da minha mão, para que vosso Deus vos possa livrar da minha mão?

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה אַל־ יַשִּׁיא֩ אֶתְכֶ֨ם חִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ וְאַל־ יַסִּ֨ית אֶתְכֶ֣ם כָּזֹאת֮ וְאַל־ תַּאֲמִ֣ינוּ לוֹ֒ כִּי־ לֹ֣א יוּכַ֗ל כָּל־ אֱל֙וֹהַ֙ כָּל־ גּ֣וֹי וּמַמְלָכָ֔ה לְהַצִּ֥יל עַמּ֛וֹ מִיָּדִ֖י וּמִיַּ֣ד אֲבוֹתָ֑י אַ֚ף כִּ֣י אֱ‍ֽלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם לֹא־ יַצִּ֥ילוּ אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִיָּדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’al- yaš·šî ’eṯ·ḵem ḥiz·qî·yā·hū wə·’al- yas·sîṯ ’eṯ·ḵem kā·zōṯ wə·’al- ta·’ă·mî·nū lōw kî- lō yū·ḵal kāl- ’ĕ·lō·w·ha kāl- gō·w ū·mam·lā·ḵāh lə·haṣ·ṣîl ‘am·mōw mî·yā·ḏî ū·mî·yaḏ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯāy ’ap̄ kî ’ĕlō·hê·ḵem lō- yaṣ·ṣî·lū ’eṯ·ḵem mî·yā·ḏî
verses.literal: So now do not let Hezekiah deceive you and do not let him mislead you like this Do not believe him for no . . . god of any nation or kingdom has been able to deliver his people from my hand or from the hand of my fathers How much less . . . will your God . . . deliver you from my hand
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, não vos engane Ezequias, nem vos incite assim, nem lhe deis crédito; porque nenhum deus de nação alguma, nem de reino algum, pôde livrar o seu povo da minha mão, nem da mão de meus pais; quanto menos vos poderá livrar o vosso Deus da minha mão?

verses.original: וְעוֹד֙ דִּבְּר֣וּ עֲבָדָ֔יו עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל יְחִזְקִיָּ֥הוּ עַבְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ō·wḏ dib·bə·rū ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ‘al- Yah·weh hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·‘al yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ‘aḇ·dōw
verses.literal: And the servants of Sennacherib spoke further against the LORD God and against His servant Hezekiah
verses.literalPt: Também seus servos falaram ainda mais contra o SENHOR Deus, e contra Ezequias, o seu servo.

verses.original: וּסְפָרִ֣ים כָּתַ֔ב לְחָרֵ֕ף לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֵֽאמֹ֨ר עָלָ֜יו לֵאמֹ֗ר כֵּֽאלֹהֵ֞י גּוֹיֵ֤ הָאֲרָצוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־ הִצִּ֤ילוּ עַמָּם֙ מִיָּדִ֔י כֵּ֣ן לֹֽא־ יַצִּ֞יל אֱלֹהֵ֧י יְחִזְקִיָּ֛הוּ עַמּ֖וֹ מִיָּדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·sə·p̄ā·rîm kā·ṯaḇ lə·ḥā·rêp̄ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl wə·lê·mōr ‘ā·lāw lê·mōr kê·lō·hê gō·w·yê hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ’ă·šer lō- hiṣ·ṣî·lū ‘am·mām mî·yā·ḏî kên lō- yaṣ·ṣîl ’ĕ·lō·hê yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ‘am·mōw mî·yā·ḏî
verses.literal: He also wrote letters mocking the LORD the God of Israel and saying against Him . . . Just as the gods of the nations . . . did not deliver their people from my hand so the God of Hezekiah will not deliver His people from my hand
verses.literalPt: Escreveu também cartas, para blasfemar do SENHOR Deus de Israel, e para falar contra ele, dizendo: Assim como os deuses das nações das terras não livraram o seu povo da minha mão, assim também o Deus de Ezequias não livrará o seu povo da minha mão.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרְא֨וּ בְקוֹל־ גָּד֜וֹל יְהוּדִ֗ית עַל־ עַ֤ם יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הַֽחוֹמָ֔ה לְיָֽרְאָ֖ם וּֽלְבַהֲלָ֑ם לְמַ֖עַן יִלְכְּד֥וּ אֶת־ הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rə·’ū ḇə·qō·wl- gā·ḏō·wl yə·hū·ḏîṯ ‘al- ‘am yə·rū·šā·lim ’ă·šer ‘al- ha·ḥō·w·māh lə·yā·rə·’ām ū·lə·ḇa·hă·lām lə·ma·‘an yil·kə·ḏū ’eṯ- hā·‘îr
verses.literal: Then the Assyrians called out loudly . . . in Hebrew to the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall to frighten and terrify them in order to capture the city
verses.literalPt: E clamaram em alta voz em judaico contra o povo de Jerusalém, que estava em cima do muro, para os atemorizar e os perturbar, para que tomassem a cidade.

verses.original: וַֽיְדַבְּר֔וּ אֶל־ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כְּעַ֗ל אֱלֹהֵי֙ עַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְדֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bə·rū ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hê yə·rū·šā·lim kə·‘al ’ĕ·lō·hê ‘am·mê hā·’ā·reṣ ma·‘ă·śêh yə·ḏê hā·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: They spoke against the God of Jerusalem as they had spoken against the gods of the peoples of the earth the work of human hands
verses.literalPt: E falaram do Deus de Jerusalém, como dos deuses dos povos da terra, obras das mãos dos homens.

verses.original: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֞ל יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וִֽישַֽׁעְיָ֧הוּ בֶן־ אָמ֛וֹץ הַנָּבִ֖יא עַל־ זֹ֑את וַֽיִּזְעֲק֖וּ הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·pal·lêl yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ham·me·leḵ wî·ša‘·yā·hū ḇen- ’ā·mō·wṣ han·nā·ḇî ‘al- zōṯ way·yiz·‘ă·qū haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: In response . . . King Hezekiah and the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz cried out to heaven in prayer
verses.literalPt: Porém o rei Ezequias e o profeta Isaías, filho de Amós, oraram contra isso, e clamaram ao céu.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ מַלְאָ֔ךְ וַיַּכְחֵ֞ד כָּל־ גִּבּ֥וֹר חַ֙יִל֙ וְנָגִ֣יד וְשָׂ֔ר בְּמַחֲנֵ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וַיָּשָׁב֩ בְּבֹ֨שֶׁת פָּנִ֜ים לְאַרְצ֗וֹ וַיָּבֹא֙ בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהָ֔יו וּמִיצִיאוֹ מֵעָ֔יו שָׁ֖ם הִפִּילֻ֥הוּ בֶחָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ Yah·weh mal·’āḵ way·yaḵ·ḥêḏ kāl- gib·bō·wr ḥa·yil wə·nā·ḡîḏ wə·śār bə·ma·ḥă·nêh me·leḵ ’aš·šūr way·yā·šāḇ bə·ḇō·šeṯ pā·nîm lə·’ar·ṣōw way·yā·ḇō bêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hāw ū·mī·ṣī·ʾō mê·‘āw šām hip·pî·lu·hū ḇe·ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: and the LORD sent an angel who annihilated every mighty man of valor and every leader and commander in the camp of the king of Assyria So he withdrew to his own land in disgrace . . . And when he entered the temple of his god some of his own sons struck him down with the sword
verses.literalPt: Então o SENHOR enviou um anjo que destruiu a todos os homens valentes, e os líderes, e os capitães no arraial do rei da Assíria; e envergonhado voltou à sua terra; e, entrando na casa de seu deus, alguns dos seus próprios filhos, o mataram ali à espada.

verses.original: וַיּוֹשַׁע֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶת־ יְחִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ וְאֵ֣ת׀ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם מִיַּ֛ד סַנְחֵרִ֥יב מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁ֖וּר וּמִיַּד־ כֹּ֑ל וַֽיְנַהֲלֵ֖ם מִסָּבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·wō·ša‘ Yah·weh ’eṯ- yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū wə·’êṯ yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim mî·yaḏ san·ḥê·rîḇ me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr ū·mî·yaḏ- kōl way·na·hă·lêm mis·sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: So the LORD - saved Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem from the hands of King Sennacherib of Assyria and all others and He gave them rest on every side
verses.literalPt: Assim livrou o SENHOR a Ezequias, e aos moradores de Jerusalém, da mão de Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria, e da mão de todos; e de todos os lados os guiou.

verses.original: וְ֠רַבִּים מְבִיאִ֨ים מִנְחָ֤ה לַיהוָה֙ לִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וּמִ֨גְדָּנ֔וֹת לִֽיחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּנַּשֵּׂ֛א לְעֵינֵ֥י כָל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם מֵאַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·rab·bîm mə·ḇî·’îm min·ḥāh Yah·weh lî·rū·šā·lim ū·miḡ·dā·nō·wṯ lî·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh way·yin·naś·śê lə·‘ê·nê ḵāl hag·gō·w·yim mê·’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên
verses.literal: Many brought offerings to Jerusalem for the LORD and valuable gifts for Hezekiah king of Judah and from then on he was exalted in the eyes of all nations
verses.literalPt: E muitos traziam a Jerusalém presentes ao SENHOR, e coisas preciosíssimas a Ezequias, rei de Judá, de modo que depois disto foi exaltado perante os olhos de todas as nações.

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם חָלָ֥ה יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ עַד־ לָמ֑וּת וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ וּמוֹפֵ֖ת נָ֥תַן לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm ḥā·lāh yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ‘aḏ- lā·mūṯ way·yiṯ·pal·lêl ’el- Yah·weh way·yō·mer lōw ū·mō·w·p̄êṯ nā·ṯan lōw
verses.literal: In those days Hezekiah became mortally ill So he prayed to the LORD who spoke to him and gave him a sign
verses.literalPt: Naqueles dias Ezequias adoeceu mortalmente; e orou ao SENHOR, o qual lhe falou, e lhe deu um sinal.

verses.original: וְלֹא־ כִגְמֻ֤ל עָלָיו֙ הֵשִׁ֣יב יְחִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ כִּ֥י גָבַ֖הּ לִבּ֑וֹ וַיְהִ֤י עָלָיו֙ קֶ֔צֶף וְעַל־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ḵiḡ·mul ‘ā·lāw hê·šîḇ yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū kî ḡā·ḇah lib·bōw way·hî ‘ā·lāw qe·ṣep̄ wə·‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: But because his heart was proud Hezekiah did not repay the favor shown to him Therefore wrath came upon him and upon Judah and Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Mas não correspondeu Ezequias ao benefício que lhe fora feito; porque o seu coração se exaltou; por isso veio grande ira sobre ele, e sobre Judá e Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיִּכָּנַ֤ע יְחִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ בְּגֹ֣בַהּ לִבּ֔וֹ ה֖וּא וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְלֹא־ בָ֤א עֲלֵיהֶם֙ קֶ֣צֶף יְהוָ֔ה בִּימֵ֖י יְחִזְקִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yik·kā·na‘ yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū bə·ḡō·ḇah lib·bōw hū wə·yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim wə·lō- ḇā ‘ă·lê·hem qe·ṣep̄ Yah·weh bî·mê yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū
verses.literal: Then Hezekiah humbled the pride of his heart he and the people of Jerusalem so that the wrath of the LORD did not come upon them during the days of Hezekiah
verses.literalPt: Ezequias, porém, se humilhou pela exaltação do seu coração, ele e os habitantes de Jerusalém; e a grande ira do SENHOR não veio sobre eles, nos dias de Ezequias.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֧י לִֽיחִזְקִיָּ֛הוּ עֹ֥שֶׁר וְכָב֖וֹד הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וְאֹֽצָר֣וֹת עָֽשָׂה־ ל֠וֹ לְכֶ֨סֶף וּלְזָהָ֜ב וּלְאֶ֣בֶן יְקָרָ֗ה וְלִבְשָׂמִים֙ וּלְמָ֣גִנִּ֔ים וּלְכֹ֖ל כְּלֵ֥י חֶמְדָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî lî·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ‘ō·šer wə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ har·bêh mə·’ōḏ wə·’ō·ṣā·rō·wṯ ‘ā·śāh- lōw lə·ḵe·sep̄ ū·lə·zā·hāḇ ū·lə·’e·ḇen yə·qā·rāh wə·liḇ·śā·mîm ū·lə·mā·ḡin·nîm ū·lə·ḵōl kə·lê ḥem·dāh
verses.literal: Hezekiah had very great riches and honor and he made treasuries for his silver gold precious stones spices shields and all kinds of valuable articles
verses.literalPt: E teve Ezequias riquezas e glória em grande abundância; proveu-se de tesouraria para prata, ouro, pedras preciosas, especiarias, escudos, e toda a espécie de objetos desejáveis.

verses.original: וּמִ֨סְכְּנ֔וֹת לִתְבוּאַ֥ת דָּגָ֖ן וְתִיר֣וֹשׁ וְיִצְהָ֑ר וְאֻֽרָוֺת֙ לְכָל־ בְּהֵמָ֣ה וּבְהֵמָ֔ה וַעֲדָרִ֖ים לָאֲוֵרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mis·kə·nō·wṯ liṯ·ḇū·’aṯ dā·ḡān wə·ṯî·rō·wōš wə·yiṣ·hār wə·’u·rā·wōṯ lə·ḵāl bə·hê·māh ū·ḇə·hê·māh wa·‘ă·ḏā·rîm lā·’ă·wê·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: He also made storehouses for the harvest of grain and new wine and oil stalls for all kinds of livestock . . . and pens for the flocks
verses.literalPt: Também de armazéns para a colheita do trigo, e do vinho, e do azeite; e de estrebarias para toda a espécie de animais e de currais para os rebanhos.

verses.original: וְעָרִים֙ עָ֣שָׂה ל֔וֹ וּמִקְנֵה־ צֹ֥אן וּבָקָ֖ר לָרֹ֑ב כִּ֤י נָֽתַן־ לוֹ֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים רְכ֖וּשׁ רַ֥ב מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·rîm ‘ā·śāh lōw ū·miq·nêh- ṣōn ū·ḇā·qār lā·rōḇ kî nā·ṯan- lōw ’ĕ·lō·hîm rə·ḵūš raḇ mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: He made cities for himself and he acquired herds of sheep and cattle in abundance for God gave him very great wealth
verses.literalPt: Edificou também cidades, e possuiu ovelhas e vacas em abundância; porque Deus lhe tinha dado muitíssimas possessões.

verses.original: וְה֣וּא יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ סָתַם֙ אֶת־ מוֹצָ֞א מֵימֵ֤י גִיחוֹן֙ הָֽעֶלְי֔וֹן וַֽיַּישְּׁרֵ֥ם לְמַֽטָּה־ מַּעְרָ֖בָה לְעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַיַּצְלַ֥ח יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּכָֽל־ מַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū sā·ṯam ’eṯ- mō·w·ṣā mê·mê ḡî·ḥō·wn hā·‘el·yō·wn way·yayš·šə·rêm lə·maṭ·ṭāh- ma‘·rā·ḇāh lə·‘îr dā·wîḏ way·yaṣ·laḥ yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū bə·ḵāl ma·‘ă·śê·hū
verses.literal: It was Hezekiah who blocked the upper outlet of the Spring of Gihon and channeled it down to the west side of the City of David And Hezekiah prospered in all that he did
verses.literalPt: Também o mesmo Ezequias tapou o manancial superior das águas de Giom, e as fez correr por baixo para o ocidente da cidade de Davi; porque Ezequias prosperou em todas as suas obras.

verses.original: וְכֵ֞ן בִּמְלִיצֵ֣י׀ שָׂרֵ֣י בָּבֶ֗ל הַֽמְשַׁלְּחִ֤ים עָלָיו֙ לִדְרֹ֗שׁ הַמּוֹפֵת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה בָאָ֔רֶץ עֲזָב֖וֹ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים לְנַ֨סּוֹת֔וֹ לָדַ֖עַת כָּל־ בִּלְבָבֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵên bim·lî·ṣê śā·rê bā·ḇel ham·šal·lə·ḥîm ‘ā·lāw liḏ·rōš ham·mō·w·p̄êṯ ’ă·šer hā·yāh ḇā·’ā·reṣ ‘ă·zā·ḇōw hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·nas·sō·w·ṯōw lā·ḏa·‘aṯ kāl- bil·ḇā·ḇōw
verses.literal: And so when ambassadors of the rulers of Babylon were sent to him to inquire about the wonder that had happened in the land God left him alone to test him that He might know all that was in Hezekiah’s heart
verses.literalPt: Contudo, no tocante aos embaixadores dos príncipes de Babilônia, que foram enviados a ele, a perguntarem acerca do prodígio que se fez naquela terra, Deus o desamparou, para tentá-lo, para saber tudo o que havia no seu coração.

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ וַחֲסָדָ֑יו הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים בַּחֲז֞וֹן יְשַֽׁעְיָ֤הוּ בֶן־ אָמוֹץ֙ הַנָּבִ֔יא עַל־ סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵי־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū wa·ḥă·sā·ḏāw hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm ba·ḥă·zō·wn yə·ša‘·yā·hū ḇen- ’ā·mō·wṣ han·nā·ḇî ‘al- sê·p̄er mal·ḵê- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Hezekiah and his deeds of loving devotion they are indeed written in the vision of the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel
verses.literalPt: Quanto aos demais atos de Ezequias, e as suas boas obras, eis que estão escritos na visão do profeta Isaías, filho de Amós, e no livro dos reis de Judá e de Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֨ב יְחִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֗יו וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ֮ בְּֽמַעֲלֵה֮ קִבְרֵ֣י בְנֵי־ דָוִיד֒ וְכָבוֹד֙ עָֽשׂוּ־ ל֣וֹ בְמוֹת֔וֹ כָּל־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·bə·ru·hū bə·ma·‘ă·lêh qiḇ·rê ḇə·nê- ḏā·wîḏ wə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ ‘ā·śū- lōw ḇə·mō·w·ṯōw kāl- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim way·yim·lōḵ mə·naš·šeh ḇə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Hezekiah rested . . . with his fathers and was buried in the upper tombs of David’s descendants All Judah and the people of Jerusalem paid him honor at his death And his son Manasseh reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E dormiu Ezequias com seus pais, e o sepultaram no mais alto dos sepulcros dos filhos de Davi; e todo o Judá e os habitantes de Jerusalém lhe fizeram honras na sua morte; e Manassés, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
